how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DMHO Ri-Bhoi Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://ribhoi.gov.in/dmho/.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Staff Nurse: General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) Nursing / B.Sc Nursing from an Institution recognized by Nursing Council of India and registered under Meghalaya Nursing Council. Applicants should be permanent residents of Ri-Bhoi District.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Staff Nurse: Rs. 30,000 per month on a contractual basis for a period of 6 months.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DMHO Ri-Bhoi Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://ribhoi.gov.in/dmho/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is conducted by the Office of the District Medical & Health Officer Ri-Bhoi District Nongpoh Government of Meghalaya (DMHO Ri-Bhoi) for healthcare positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: A total of 20 vacancies are available for the Staff Nurse position under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 12 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM at the designated office address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) Nursing or B.Sc Nursing degree and must be registered with the Meghalaya Nursing Council.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary for the Staff Nurse position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Staff Nurse post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for DMHO Ri-Bhoi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in offline mode only by delivering the hard copy of the application form and testimonials to the office.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job location for these vacancies?
faq.answer: The job postings are primarily for the MCH Hospital, Umsning within the Ri-Bhoi District of Meghalaya.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any residency requirement for applicants?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants should be permanent residents of Ri-Bhoi District and must submit valid proof of residence along with their application.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection procedure for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a screening process, followed by a written test and an interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application form be submitted?
faq.answer: The filled application form along with relevant certificates must be submitted at the Office of the District Medical & Health Officer Ri-Bhoi District Nongpoh, Received and Issue Section Room No 19 (1st Floor).
